title: PRISM SQUADRON
oneLiner: Original fixed-screen formation shooter with marching ranks, telegraphed divers, destructible shields, bonus UFOs and cooperative play.
mechanics: Marching alien ranks accelerate as the wave thins and gradually descend.
Divers visibly warn before following a bounded dive and returning to their slot.
Both sides chip permanent holes through four optional defensive bunkers.
Shoot the bonus UFO, clear all waves and earn a wave bonus.
Each player has independent movement, lives, fire and a timed energy shield.
lose: The team loses all lives to bullets, divers or advancing invaders.
scoring: 50–80 for marching enemies, 200 for divers, 500 for the UFO and 500 per completed wave.
